snippet.title: Foundation Footy: Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Foundation Footy is a top-down arcade rugby league game set in the sport's foundation years, 1908 to 1947. Play 72 historic sides solo, on the couch or online.

Out now in Early Access on Steam for Windows, macOS and Linux:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5466560/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer

Made by Fisher's Ghost Studios in Campbelltown, NSW.
https://fishersghoststudios.com/

Foundation Footy is not affiliated with, endorsed by or licensed by the NRL, the NSWRL, the QRL, the RFL, the NZRL or any club or representative body.
